# Roboticist
1. Your direct superior is the Research Director.
2. A minimum of one positronic brain must be active and on hand at all times.
3. Roboticists are expected to have a maximum of two empty borg chassis constructed and ready at all times.
4. Roboticists are to consult with the Research Director before any mech suits are made. Both the Head of Security and Research Director must approve combat-focused mechs being built.
5. It is the Roboticists responsibility to routinely bring newly acquired machinery and technologies to their departments, either in flatpack form, or with the materials to construct the machine on site.
6. The Roboticist is expected to verify newly activated cyborg laws to ensure that they will not be a danger to Nanotrasen property.
